_description: Units available for training, per faction (random armies, tools/nn/armies, docs/en/training/armies.md). A new unit or faction is a new entry here; its passport must be in config/nn/units.json (cost multiplayer_cost, category, men). slot: the unit's name in an army (slot_1, slot_2, ...); width: frontage in m at deployment (default men / rank_depth files x 1.5 m).

caps._description: Share of an army's units (the lord counted) that may be of one passport category, rounded down, at least 1. Against degenerate stacks; see docs/en/training/armies.md.
